sentences.text:
Chaudhary R/o Village- Chhota Katora, P.O.- Mocharim, P.S.- Bodhgaya,
 District- Gaya

1. The State of Bihar  2. Babita Devi Wife of Vicky Chaudhary @ Vikky Chaudhary @ Vikky  Kumar, D/o Madheshwar Chaudhary R/o Village- Chhota Katora, P.S.-
 Mocharim, P.S.- Bodhgaya, Dist.- Gaya at present residing at Village-  Koilwan Tola Raghunath Bigha, P.S.- Haspura, Dist.- Aurangabad  ... ... Opposite

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Binod Kumar Sinha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Ms.Asha Kumari, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 04-04-2025 1. Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 116/2023 for the offence under Section 498A I.P.C.
3.
It is a case of matrimonial dispute between the petitioner and opposite party no. 2.
Petitioner -Vicky Chaudhary is the husband of opposite party no. 2- Babita Devi.
Allegation against the petitioner and his family members is of torturing and assaulting the informant due to nonfulfillment of demand of dowry.
4. Earlier, this case was referred to Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court, Patna where matter was Patna High Court CR.

entities.text: Mediation and Conciliation Center, Patna High Court, Patna
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
MISC. No.65245 of 2024(4) dt.04-04-2025 amicably settled between the parties and for the same Memorandum of Agreement has been sent by the learned Mediator.
5.
During course of argument, learned counsel for both the parties submits that both the parties are now living together and leading their conjugal life happily and now there is no dispute between them.

Vicky Chaudhary @ Vikky Chaudhary @ ... vs The State Of Bihar on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55561193/
1 6.

entities.text: Vicky Chaudhary @ Vikky Chaudhary @ ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Keeping in view the aforesaid facts and comprise between the parties, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail, let the petitioner be enlarged on anticipatory bail in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from the receipt/production of this order,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) each with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Daudnagar, Aurangabad in connection with Complaint Case No. 116/2023 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) tusharika/-
